flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds show a moderate gain for the Democrats' chances of taking control of the Senate. The market also shows the Democrat Adam Hamilton gaining ground in [[Kansas]], a predicted flip, and the Democrat Mary Peltola moving up in [[Alaska]], also a predicted flip. In [[Nebraska]], the Republican Pete Ricketts saw a sizable rise in their chances.
summaries.governor: The sharpest move was in [[Florida]], where Polymarket odds show a sharp drop in the chances of the Republican, Byron Donalds. In [[Georgia]], the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms gained ground by a sizable amount, and the market treats it as a predicted flip. In [[Kansas]], the Republican Ty Masterson saw a sizable fall in their chances, also a predicted flip.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show the Democrats favoured to win House control, with their chances edging up slightly. The biggest move came in [[FL-09 (Orlando & Kissimmee)]], where the Republican, Dan Green, saw a sharp drop in chances, and the market treats it as a predicted flip. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott gained ground sharply, while in [[FL-14 (Plant City)]] the Democrat Kathy Castor made a sizable improvement.
